description: This file defines a catalog for discovering and managing system sound effects, including locating sound files in standard directories, filtering by allowed extensions, and providing an interface to retrieve and play sounds by name or bookmark.

classes.name: SoundEffectCatalog
classes.description: A static utility enum that provides system sound names, paths, and discovery mechanisms for sound files stored in common directories.

classes.name: SoundEffectPlayer
classes.description: A singleton utility enum that handles loading sounds by name or bookmark data and playing them.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of discoverable system sound names with 'Glass' pinned first.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns the display name for a given raw sound name (currently a pass-through).

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the URL associated with a sound name from the discovered sound map.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Retrieves an NSSound object for a given sound name, either by system name or from discovered URLs.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound object from bookmark data, with security scope access handling.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Plays the provided NSSound object, stopping the previous sound if needed.
